name: Twincity Marathon 2027
short_description: Twincity Marathon 2027 is a road race weekend in Putrajaya, Malaysia, with the marathon, half marathon, 12 km and 5 km starting at Dataran Putrajaya on Sunday 24 January 2027.
ai_summary: Twincity Marathon 2027, organised by Ten Senses (M) Sdn Bhd, is held in Putrajaya, Malaysia. On Sunday 24 January 2027 the 42.195 km marathon (2.30am start, eight-hour limit), 21.1 km half marathon, 12 km and 5 km start at Dataran Putrajaya; in 2026 the marathon and half-marathon courses also ran through neighbouring Cyberjaya. On Saturday 23 January a 10 km Friendship Run and a 3 km Kids Dash start at the Putrajaya International Convention Centre (PICC). The start moved from Cyberjaya to Putrajaya in 2026.

core_facts.venue: Dataran Putrajaya, Presint 3 (Sunday races); Putrajaya International Convention Centre (Saturday races)

pros: Eight-hour marathon cut-off suits slower runners
Race-morning air of 24-25°C from the 2.45am start to 8.30am in 2026
Route crosses both Putrajaya and Cyberjaya from a Dataran Putrajaya start
Cash prizes three deep and trophies to 10th in Malaysian open and veteran categories
Half marathon, 12 km, 5 km and Saturday 10 km and 3 km for non-marathoners
cons: Very early starts: 2.45am marathon in 2026, 2.30am in 2027
Crowded start: one half marathoner took over ten minutes to cross the start line
Only partial road closures on parts of the Cyberjaya section
Entries were non-refundable and non-transferable in 2026

faqs.question: When does the Twincity Marathon 2027 take place?
faqs.answer: The main races are on Sunday 24 January 2027, with the marathon starting at 2.30am and the half marathon at 3.45am from Dataran Putrajaya. The 10 km Friendship Run and 3 km Kids Dash are on Saturday 23 January at PICC. Race packs are collected at PICC from 21 to 23 January.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Twincity Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: Six: a 42.195 km marathon, a 21.1 km half marathon, a 12 km and a 5 km on Sunday, plus a 10 km Friendship Run and a 3 km Kids Dash on Saturday. On the organiser's 2027 fee list, entry ranges from RM50 for the kids' dash to RM165 for international marathon runners.

faqs.question: Where is the Twincity Marathon 2027 held?
faqs.answer: In Putrajaya. Since 2026 the Sunday races have started and finished at Dataran Putrajaya in Presint 3, having moved from Cyberjaya to fit a larger field, and in 2026 the marathon route ran through Cyberjaya before returning. The Saturday races start at the Putrajaya International Convention Centre (PICC).
